catalog_quote: The factors unified under the stress umbrella will be shown to occur almost entirely on the penultimate or antepenultimate syllables of words. The latter case will be seen to only occur only if the final syllable begins with one of [k, ʧ, ŋ], similar to the the “weak” syllables of OM. ... all antepenultimate stress is due to underlyingly consonant-final forms, which receive penultimate stress, but also an epenthetic vowel ignored by stress assignment. ... The usual case for Betsimisaraka words is for emphasis to be heard on the penultimate syllable ... [mi'roŋku] “close” ... [ma'venti] “big” ... [an'deha] “go” ... Still, it is not at all uncommon for words, like those in Table 5.2 below, to be heard exhibiting antepenultimate stress. ... 'hudiʧi “skin” ... 'lavaka “hole” ... audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: all fragments of the deciding quotation, the domain quote, the exception quote and the secondary-stress example are verbatim in the held O'Neill 2015 PDF/text at the cited pages (114, 122-124 with fnn.74-75, Tables 5.1-5.3, 130-131). (2) Deciding source is a 2015 PhD phonological grammar with a full stress chapter based on the author's own fieldwork and acoustic measurements; Glottolog 5.1 lists it as the sole descriptive reference for nort2890, and web search (UDSpace, ERIC, NSF, Speech Prosody 2020, JIPA) turns up nothing newer or more specific on Betsimisaraka stress; the dissertation itself identifies its variety as Northern Betsimisaraka, so the languoid match is right. sources.quote: "Although stress commonly falls on the penultimate syllable, it may also occur on the antepenult and ultimate syllable, sometimes creating phonemic contrast. In the text presented in 6.1., primary stress (') is marked on the stressed syllable in the phonemic transcription line." (same field site, Vavatenina). Also p.9-10: unstressed final vowels devoiced/deleted; /i/ realised [i] only when stressed.
sources.note: Only other primary phonological note on Northern Betsimisaraka (same town, Vavatenina); independent confirmation of penultimate default with antepenultimate/final surface stress. downloaded now; one-sentence stress section, adds a stress-marked text but no conditioning analysis.
